Definition: a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh
BiblicalUsage: A Beth-shemite is a man of Beth-shemesh, house of the sun — and the word is tied to the ark's return. In 1 Samuel 6:14 the cart carrying the ark came into the field of Joshua, a Beth-shemite, and stood there by a great stone. In 1 Samuel 6:18 the golden mice are counted for every Philistine city, down to the country villages of the Beth-shemites.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Beth-shemites remind me that God's ark can come home to an ordinary field, and ordinary men have to decide what to do with it.
